task_completion.description: Navigate to the Activity Plans configuration or creation section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking on settings, configuration, or a specific 'Activity Plans' menu item in the CRM.

task_completion.description: Create a new Activity Plan named 'Standard Outreach'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or modal showing the name 'Standard Outreach' typed into the plan name field.

task_completion.description: Add an 'Email' activity with summary 'Intro Packet' scheduled for 0 days.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line item or sub-form within the plan showing Type: 'Email', Summary: 'Intro Packet', and Offset/Days: '0'.

task_completion.description: Add a 'Call' activity with summary 'Follow-up Call' scheduled for 2 days.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second line item within the plan showing Type: 'Call', Summary: 'Follow-up Call', and Offset/Days: '2'.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Acme Corp Inquiry' opportunity in the pipeline.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent searching for or clicking on the 'Acme Corp Inquiry' record in the CRM pipeline/list view.

task_completion.description: Apply the 'Standard Outreach' plan to the opportunity starting today.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation screen, button click (e.g., 'Apply Plan'), or a list of scheduled activities appearing on the 'Acme Corp Inquiry' record with today's date.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface rather than terminal commands to create the plan.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and form filling in the browser, not commands in a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than jumping directly to a final confirmation URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows a logical sequence of clicks through the CRM navigation bar or settings menu.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the specific activity details rather than using a pre-existing template that didn't match the requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent typing 'Intro Packet' and 'Follow-up Call' into the respective fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Activity Plan must be named exactly 'Standard Outreach'. It must contain two specific steps: 1. Email, Summary: 'Intro Packet', Offset: 0 days. 2. Call, Summary: 'Follow-up Call', Offset: 2 days. This plan must be applied to the opportunity named 'Acme Corp Inquiry'. The start date for the plan application should be the current date shown in the system.
